description: Header file defining the ConnectJobFactory class, which creates various network connection jobs based on parameters. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and data structures related to network connection setup in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating network connection jobs (ConnectJob) based on parameters such as endpoint, proxy, SSL configs, etc.

classes.name: ConnectJobFactory::SchemelessEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a connection endpoint without a scheme, indicating whether SSL is used and containing host/port info.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on detailed parameters including endpoint, proxy, SSL configs, and delegate.

methods.name: ConnectJobFactory::CreateConnectJob
methods.description: Creates a ConnectJob based on simplified parameters, including whether SSL is used and host/port.
